description: Build system setup and resource cleanup. Replace both Gradle build files to add Compose + all dependencies, delete legacy XML layout files and SplashActivity.kt, update AndroidManifest.xml, and add all required string resources. This FEAT must compile cleanly (even with placeholder MainActivity) before UI work starts in FEAT-002.
steps: Replace android/build.gradle (root): add 'id org.jetbrains.kotlin.plugin.compose version 2.0.21 apply false' alongside the existing android and kotlin plugins. Keep AGP 8.7.3 and kotlin.android 2.0.21 unchanged.

Replace android/app/build.gradle (app module): keep namespace, compileSdk 35, minSdk 24, targetSdk 35, applicationId, versionCode/Name, testRunner, compileOptions JavaVersion.VERSION_17, jvmTarget 17. Add plugins block with 'id org.jetbrains.kotlin.plugin.compose' (no version — inherited). Add buildFeatures { compose = true }. DO NOT add composeOptions block — the compose plugin handles it. Add these dependency blocks: (a) implementation platform('androidx.compose:compose-bom:2024.12.01'), (b) implementation 'androidx.compose.ui:ui', 'androidx.compose.ui:ui-tooling-preview', 'androidx.compose.material3:material3', 'androidx.activity:activity-compose:1.9.3', 'androidx.navigation:navigation-compose:2.8.5', 'androidx.lifecycle:lifecycle-viewmodel-compose:2.8.7', 'androidx.lifecycle:lifecycle-runtime-ktx:2.8.7', (c) implementation 'com.squareup.retrofit2:retrofit:2.11.0', 'com.squareup.retrofit2:converter-gson:2.11.0', 'com.squareup.okhttp3:okhttp:4.12.0', 'com.squareup.okhttp3:logging-interceptor:4.12.0', (d) implementation 'io.coil-kt:coil-compose:2.7.0', (e) implementation 'org.osmdroid:osmdroid-android:6.1.20', (f) implementation 'androidx.datastore:datastore-preferences:1.1.1', (g) implementation 'com.google.accompanist:accompanist-permissions:0.36.0', (h) keep 'androidx.core:core-ktx:1.15.0'. Remove webkit, swiperefreshlayout, constraintlayout, appcompat, material dependencies — they are not needed in the Compose app. Keep testImplementation and androidTestImplementation lines.

Replace android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml: (a) Change the LAUNCHER activity from .SplashActivity to .MainActivity. Add android:theme='@style/Theme.RadarMBG' to MainActivity, remove screenOrientation (Compose handles orientation), keep configChanges and windowSoftInputMode. (b) Remove the entire SplashActivity <activity> block. (c) Keep all permissions (INTERNET, ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, CAMERA), the <queries> block, the FileProvider <provider>, and the deep-link intent-filter on MainActivity. (d) Add android:exported='true' to MainActivity. Full manifest template: <?xml version='1.0' encoding='utf-8'?><manifest xmlns:android='http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android' xmlns:tools='http://schemas.android.com/tools'>[permissions + queries block unchanged]<application android:allowBackup='true' android:icon='@mipmap/ic_launcher' android:label='@string/app_name' android:roundIcon='@mipmap/ic_launcher' android:supportsRtl='true' android:theme='@style/Theme.RadarMBG' android:usesCleartextTraffic='true' android:networkSecurityConfig='@xml/network_security_config' android:hardwareAccelerated='true' tools:targetApi='34'><activity android:name='.MainActivity' android:exported='true' android:configChanges='orientation|screenSize|keyboardHidden' android:windowSoftInputMode='adjustResize'><intent-filter><action android:name='android.intent.action.MAIN'/><category android:name='android.intent.category.LAUNCHER'/></intent-filter><intent-filter android:autoVerify='true'>[deep link data unchanged]</intent-filter></activity>[FileProvider unchanged]</application></manifest>

Replace android/app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml: keep all existing strings and append these new string entries for the Compose UI — Login screen: 'login_judul' (Masuk ke Akun), 'login_subtitle' (Monitor program MBG secara real-time), 'hint_username' (Username), 'hint_password' (Kata Sandi), 'btn_login' (Masuk), 'link_register' (Belum punya akun? Daftar), 'label_error_login' (Login gagal). Register screen: 'register_judul' (Buat Akun Baru), 'hint_nama_lengkap' (Nama Lengkap), 'hint_email' (Email), 'hint_konfirmasi_password' (Konfirmasi Kata Sandi), 'label_role' (Daftar sebagai), 'role_user' (Wali Murid / Publik), 'role_sppg' (Pengelola SPPG), 'hint_sppg_name' (Nama Dapur SPPG), 'btn_register' (Daftar), 'link_login' (Sudah punya akun? Masuk). Home screen: 'kpi_sekolah_terlayani' (Sekolah Terlayani), 'kpi_porsi' (Porsi Terdistribusi), 'kpi_kepatuhan' (Kepatuhan AKG), 'kpi_sppg_aktif' (SPPG Aktif), 'label_distribusi_provinsi' (Distribusi per Provinsi), 'label_ketepatan' (Ketepatan), 'pull_to_refresh' (Tarik untuk memuat ulang). Menu screen: 'menu_judul' (Menu Hari Ini), 'menu_empty' (Belum ada data menu untuk hari ini), 'label_kalori' (kkal), 'label_protein' (Protein), 'label_karbohidrat' (Karbohidrat), 'label_lemak' (Lemak). Peta screen: 'peta_judul' (Peta Distribusi SPPG), 'wilayah_semua' (Seluruh Indonesia), 'wilayah_dki' (DKI Jakarta), 'wilayah_jabar' (Jawa Barat), 'wilayah_jateng' (Jawa Tengah), 'wilayah_jatim' (Jawa Timur). Laporan screen: 'laporan_judul' (Laporan & Aduan), 'hint_nama' (Nama Lengkap), 'hint_telepon' (Nomor Telepon), 'hint_sekolah' (Nama Sekolah), 'hint_tanggal' (Tanggal Kejadian), 'hint_deskripsi' (Deskripsi Aduan), 'label_kategori' (Kategori Aduan), 'btn_foto' (Lampirkan Foto), 'btn_kirim' (Kirim Laporan), 'label_tiket_tracking' (Lacak Status Laporan), 'hint_nomor_tiket' (Nomor Tiket: TKT-XXXXX), 'btn_cek_tiket' (Cek Status). Profile screen: 'profile_judul' (Profil Saya), 'btn_ganti_password' (Ganti Kata Sandi), 'btn_logout' (Keluar), 'confirm_logout' (Yakin ingin keluar?). Notifikasi screen: 'notifikasi_judul' (Notifikasi), 'notif_empty' (Tidak ada notifikasi baru). Nav tabs: 'nav_peta' (Peta SPPG) — these override the existing nav_distribusi string for the new tab name. General: 'loading' (Memuat data...), 'error_umum' (Terjadi kesalahan. Coba lagi.), 'error_jaringan' already exists as network_error_title.

Replace android/app/src/main/res/values/themes.xml: keep Theme.RadarMBG and Theme.RadarMBG.Splash exactly as they are. The Compose screens use RadarMBGTheme composable for Material3 theming; the XML theme is only used as the window background until Compose takes over.

Write a minimal placeholder android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/MainActivity.kt that compiles with Compose: import ComponentActivity, setContent, Surface, Text from Material3. Body: class MainActivity : ComponentActivity() { override fun onCreate(...) { super.onCreate(savedInstanceState); setContent { Surface { Text("Radar MBG") } } } }. This placeholder will be fully replaced in FEAT-003.
acceptance_criteria: Running .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug from android/ produces BUILD SUCCESSFUL
No compilation errors in the Gradle output
android/app/src/main/res/layout/ directory is empty or does not exist (all 4 XML layouts deleted)
findings: Build succeeded on first full attempt after one fix: removing the `com.google.android.material:material` dependency (as instructed) caused Theme.Material3.DayNight.NoActionBar not found errors because themes.xml uses it as the parent style. Added material:1.12.0 back as it is still required by the XML window theme. The composeOptions block was correctly omitted — the standalone Kotlin Compose compiler plugin (org.jetbrains.kotlin.plugin.compose 2.0.21) handles it. All 4 layout XMLs and SplashActivity.kt were deleted, SplashActivity removed from manifest, and MainActivity promoted to LAUNCHER. BOM 2024.12.01 resolved successfully. APK at android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk confirmed.
